title: Geist: Healing Booster raises each Life Drain heal by 20% (why it goes right after Radiant Regeneration)
question: Does Healing Booster (HealAmpCastPercent 20) raise the health Geist gains from one full Life Drain charge, and by how much at the 9.6k state?
hypothesis: Yes: heal per 5s drain rises ~20% (calc 322 -> 387 at 9.6k state, Life Drain T3, spirit ~36). REFUTED if within 5%.

setup.level_or_boons: level 16 (9.6k souls), Life Drain T3 via abil bits 15 (not unlock 7)
setup.start_hp: hurtme to 40% so heal is never capped

controls: Cultist buff OFF in both (it adds a drain charge and health)
procedure: log Life Drain tier/charges before each block
channel one full Life Drain charge on the dummy
read health gained (healsrc if available, else HP before/after)

decision.rule: SUPPORTS early Healing Booster if B beats A by >=10% (expected ~20%); REFUTES if within 5%; else INCONCLUSIVE. Radiant Regeneration heals are a secondary log.
